sentences.text: 1 c) Directing the Respondents/Respondent No.2 to immediately add the additional relevant sections of IPC in the existing FIR as per the statement of the Petitioner U/s 164 Cr.P.C.; and/or d) Directing the Respondents/Respondent No.2 to conduct a fair, ethical and time bound investigation in FIR No. 210/2023, dated 15,05.2023 U/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Prashant Vihar and appoint a senior police officer to monitor the investigation; and/or e) Directing the Investigating Officer/Respondent No.2 to produce the Case Diary pertaining to FIR No. 210/2023, dated 15.05.2023 U/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Prashant Vihar before this Hon'ble Court to ascertain the Nature and Extent of Investigation conducted in the aforementioned particularly the steps taken by the Respondents so far; and/or f) Pass any further order or directions as this Hon'ble Court may deems fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the present case."

2. Heard.
3.
Issue notice.
Learned ASC for the State appearing on advance notice accepted notice and vehemently opposed the instant petition.
He prayed for one week's time to file status report.
Let the same be filed within one week as prayed.
4. List on 27th February, 2025.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The application stands disposed of.
The instant petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the petitioner seeking the following reliefs:
"a) Issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other Writ of the like nature directing the Respondents/Respondent No,2 to take appropriate action in accordance with Law;
and/or b) Directing the Respondents/Respondent No.2 including This
1 c) Directing the Respondents/Respondent No.2 to immediately add the additional relevant sections of IPC in the existing FIR as per the statement of the Petitioner U/s 164 Cr.P.C.; and/or d) Directing the Respondents/Respondent No.2 to conduct a fair, ethical and time bound investigation in FIR No. 210/2023, dated 15,05.2023 U/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Prashant Vihar and appoint a senior police officer to monitor the investigation; and/or e) Directing the Investigating Officer/Respondent No.2 to produce the Case Diary pertaining to FIR No. 210/2023, dated 15.05.2023 U/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Prashant Vihar before this Hon'ble Court to ascertain the Nature and Extent of Investigation conducted in the aforementioned particularly the steps taken by the Respondents so far; and/or f) Pass any further order or directions as this Hon'ble Court may deems fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the present case."
